pipeline.description: Example pipeline demonstrating true/false conditional logic with a foreach loop

variable.name: PrimaryDBConnStr
variable.description: Connection string for the primary SQL Server database

variable.name: AnalyticsDBConnStr
variable.description: Connection string for the analytics SQL Server database

variable.name: GetActiveRegionsQuery
variable.description: Query to retrieve active regions from sys.databases

variable.name: IsMasterDB
variable.description: Flag indicating if the current database is the master database

sql.description: Check if the currently connected database is the master database

flow.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN DB_NAME() = 'master' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS is_master;

if.description: Check if the current database is the master database

sql.description: Log confirmation message that connected to master database

then.sql: SELECT 'Connected to master database. Running master-level tasks...' AS notice;

foreach.description: Iterate over each active region returned by GetActiveRegionsQuery

group.description: Group of tasks processing each active region in the iteration

sql.description: Log current loop region's database ID and name to status output

group.sql: SELECT 'Processing database ID: {{database_id}}, Name: {{name}}' AS current_status;

sql.description: Log warning message when connection is not on master database

else.sql: SELECT 'Not connected to master. Skipping sys.databases loop.' AS notice;
